articles.summary: KB Home (NYSE: KBH), one of the largest and most trusted homebuilders in the U.S., today announced the opening of Brighton Crossings, a new-home community in Brighton, Colorado. Brighton Crossings at a Glance: Price: From the $460,000s Location: Brighton, Colorado, at the corner of Longs Peak Street and North Golden Eagle Parkway near Interstate 76 Home type: One- and two-story, single-family detached homes Bedrooms/baths: Up to 6 bedrooms and 3 baths School district: Brighton School District 27J Amenities: Resident access to resort-style splash pad, community and fitness center, event space, lounge, pools, parks, sports courts and playgrounds Brighton Crossings is in an ideal location that provides convenient access to Interstate 76, E-470 and Denver's major employment centers. The new community is a short drive to downtown Brighton, which offers a farmers' market, shopping, dining and entertainment. articles.summary: KB Home (NYSE: KBH) today announced that Casey Dare has been named as its Tampa Division President. In this role, Dare is responsible for the company's homebuilding operations throughout the region, from land acquisition and construction to sales and customer service. Dare brings more than 20 years of homebuilding experience and 10 years of service with KB Home. He has served many roles with the company, including superintendent, customer service manager, director of customer service and operations, senior vice president of operations, and most recently, executive vice president for the Orlando division. He holds a bachelor's degree in psychology from Middle Tennessee State University and a Master of Business Administration from Georgia Southern University. Dare also served as an active-duty officer in the United States Army for 8 years.
